{
    "content": "<p>I use Visual Studio every day for just about all of my development tasks.\nHowever, I attempted to open a large xml file (&gt; 20 megs) and Visual studio\nspiked up to 1.5 gigs of memory consumption and I couldn't do anything... My old\nstandby notepad++ (great editor!) also hung on opening the file. A quick search\nyielded <a href=\"http://www.firstobject.com/dn_editor.htm\">First Object's XML Editor</a>. Worked great. Super fast.</p>\n",
